relevance_note: Symposium summary that describes several individual FLD patients with LCAT variants, e.g. 'He was compound heterozygous for mutations R244H and M252K in exon 6 of the LCAT gene and given a diagnosis of FLD.'
method_note: Hand extraction; a short Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON from hand-chosen values and spans. The paper is a 2017 symposium summary with no tables. In-scope individuals: the 1966 Oslo index patient and her two sisters (published 1967, ref (3)); the probands of Finnish families 2 and 3 (refs (13–15) cited for the three Finnish families jointly); the 22-year-old Norwegian male and his tested parents; and the single rhLCAT-treated FLD patient of ref (38). Left out (group-level only, no identifiable person): Finnish family 1 ('Affected family members were compound heterozygotes for LCAT R399C and exon one C-insertion mutations'; 'One of the subjects had mild proteinuria' cannot be tied to an identifiable affected person, and the number of affected members is not given); the Brazilian series of 38 FLD patients from seven families (c.G803A (p.R244H), c.C4920T (p.T274I), c.A2822T (p.I203F); group statistics only); the Finnish low-HDL screening (n = 156); carrier studies (Canadian, Dutch, Italian); the phase 1 rhLCAT study; the other three Norwegian patients. Labels: rule 4 for previously published people ('ref (3) patient', 'ref (13–15) patient' = family 2 proband, 'ref (13–15) patient 2' = family 3 proband, 'ref (38) patient'); rule 6 for the Norwegian case ('unnamed person 1'), who is not said to be previously published although ref (16) (Strøm 2011, on renal lesions with early graft recurrence) is cited after the case, so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported' for him. Protein variants are printed in one-letter form without 'p.' (R399C, G230R, R244H, M252K); they are copied as printed into protein_hgvs_as_stated as well as variant_original_string. The R244H functional statement comes from the structure section ('The activator enhances the acyltransferase activity of LCAT R244H in vitro.'), a sentence naming this exact variant. Judgement calls: the sisters' corneal opacity rests on 'her two sisters had the same symptoms' following 'The patient had an opaque cornea'; low HDL for the Finnish probands rests on the named group 'the index patients'; mild microalbuminuria (family 3) was counted as proteinuria on the checklist; 'There were no other clinical findings' (family 2) is recorded as written and excludes no specific checklist item; the 1966 patient's 'Almost all the plasma cholesterol was unesterified' supports both elevated unesterified cholesterol and reduced cholesteryl ester fraction; LpX ('large amounts of membranous particles in the plasma from these patients') refers to 'the FLD patients' studied by Oslo and Seattle without clearly naming the family, so lipoprotein x is not reported. The Norwegian patient's kidney transplant at 28 is not recorded as renal failure (not stated); age at last evaluation is the transplant age (28); he presented at 22. 'ref (38) patient' advanced renal disease was counted as chronic kidney disease or renal failure. No contradictions found.
